title: Create: Bonkworks
description: A create modpack for a small server, with many create features and a few other mods to give it some spice!
body:
# Create: Bonkworks
A chaotic and creative sandbox built around the **Create** mod and everything that makes it **bonkers** fun.

## 🎡 Core Concept
**Create: Bonkworks** centers around the **Create** mod — the ultimate toolkit for kinetic engineering in Minecraft. Use rotational power, mechanical contraptions, and automation systems to build factories, farms, and machines limited only by your imagination.

## ⚙️ Addons Galore
This modpack includes a variety of **Create addons** to supercharge your engineering possibilities:
- Create Stuff 'N Additions
- Create Confectionery
- Create: Enchantment Industry
- Create: Liquid Fuel
- Create: Ultimate Factory
- [Create: Recycling Everything [NeoForge Port]](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-recycling-everything-neo) - From Curseforge!

And more!

## 🔧 Who Is This For?
- **Thinkers** and **Engineers** who love complex machines.
- **Builders** who want to bring their creations to life.
- Anyone who’s ever wanted to make complex farms call it art.

## 🚀 Let the Bonking Begin!
Download **Create: Bonkworks** and dive into a world where logic meets lunacy — all powered by gears, steam, and your endless creativity.
